'''Escort Flight''' was a squadron of [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the service of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that operated as an elite escort squadron for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' starfighter, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']].

==Description==
[[File:13thStrikeWingEmblem.svg|thumb|left|100px|An insignia on one of Escort Flight's starfighters from the [[13th Strike Wing]]]]
Escort Flight was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of the best [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]]-[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] ''Rogue''-class [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfighting]] units from at least two squadrons&mdash;one of which was the [[13th Strike Wing]].<ref name="EscortMini" /><ref name="13thMini">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=13th Strike Wing Porax-38|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw06a.jpg}}</ref> Adapted from the [[Utapau/Legends|Utapauan]] [[Porax-38 starfighter]] by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars and manufactured by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]],<ref name="Incredible">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> the starfighters of Escort Flight were modified with enhanced tactical and weapons systems. Despite the reassignment, the fighter craft retained the markings of their parent squadrons.<ref name="EscortMini" /><ref name="13thMini" />

==History==
During the Clone Wars, Escort Flight was used by Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' as his personal elite escort squadron for his starfighter, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="EscortMini" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|''Clone Wars'' expansion]] of ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' featured two ''Rogue''-class starfighter miniatures, one identified as a 13th Strike Wing Porax-38 and the other being one of two units identified as Escort Flight. Both of [[Hasbro]]'s Magnaguard Fighter toys&mdash;the Titanium miniature and 3-1/4" action vehicle&mdash;featured identical markings and color schemes as was used on the ''Star Wars PocketModel TCG'' miniatures, identifying them as belonging to the squadrons identified in the PocketModel game.<ref name="13thMini" /><ref name="EscortMini">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=Escort Flight Porax-38|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw29b.jpg}}</ref><ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=MagnaGuard Fighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWvehMagnaguard.asp}}</ref>

In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Holocron Heist]]," the starfighter greatly resembling a Porax-38 was identified as a "''Rogue''-class starfighter." ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'', published in [[2011]], then [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] all further appearances of the Porax-38 by identifying the ''Rogue''-class as an entirely different model adapted from the Porax-38 by the CIS.<ref name="Incredible" />
